MTSampleType.description: Data Items with category \mtmodel{SAMPLE}. The simplest mapping since all       these types are floating point numeric data and comply with the       \uamodel{AnalogUnitType} from \cite{UAPart8} Amendment 1. In ammendment 1,       the \uamodel{EURange} is optional. \uamodel{EngineeringUnits} for all       \mtuatype{MTSampleType} Data Items. The \uamodel{EURange} will becreated       if the \mtmodel{Constraints} element exists and both \mtmodel{Maximum} and       \mtmodel{Minimum} values are given. An XML element that provides the       information and data reported from a piece of equipment for those dataitem       elements defined with a category attribute of sample category in the       mtconnectdevices document.
